finding: GO-003 and GO-004 cite the same evidence id, and that evidence does not contain GO-004 value.

EVID-007.text: Mice received 1.2 mg/kg GFP mRNA-LNP intravenously. Six hours later, liver immunostaining showed colocalization of GFP and the LSEC marker LYVE-1.

consequence: The cell_target_effect scope returning zero outcomes was correct behaviour: all six of its candidates are qualitative colocalisation statements, none supports a 17-fold ratio.
possibilities: the evidence_id on GO-004 is wrong and should point at a passage carrying the ratio
the ratio is only legible in Figure 2B, which would place GO-004 with GO-002/GO-018 in the vision-dependent set
the ratio was inferred from the image at annotation time, in which case the project rule would make it visually_estimated and human-review, not reported_approximate
implication: If the ratio exists only in the figure, four of the fifteen gold outcomes depend on reading images and the recall target is reachable only through the vision path.
